title: Apothem Memory Record
description: One durable, agnostic, operator-portable knowledge record in the memory surface. The record shape is neutral: it carries no tool-specific or vendor-specific identifier, so the same record round-trips between any two installation targets without loss. A record captures a stable fact, convention, preference, insight, or reference worth preserving across sessions.

id.description: Stable record identifier, unique within a memory store.

title.description: One-line summary used to decide relevance during recall.

kind.description: Record taxonomy. fact: a stable observed truth. convention: a ratified practice. preference: an operator-stated choice. insight: a derived lesson. reference: a pointer to an external resource.

created.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the record was first written.

updated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the record was last amended.

source.description: Provenance — where the knowledge came from (a session, a document, an operator statement).

confidence.description: Optional confidence in the record's accuracy, in the closed interval [0, 1].
